# VA Dispatch

> VA Dispatch is open source live dispatch, scheduling and ACARS software for Virtual Airlines (flight simulation communities). This installation runs vSAS Live Operations for Virtual SAS. Licensed AGPL-3.0-or-later. Source: https://github.com/shiftbloom-studio/va-dispatcher

- Multi-tenant: one tenant is one Virtual Airline, reached under its own path (for example /vsas).
- Pilots request and fly individual schedules built by human dispatchers; dispatchers coordinate every flight together. All operational times are in UTC.
- ACARS messages go through Hoppie's ACARS with tenant-scoped, encrypted ground-station credentials.
- Sign-in uses a one-time code sent by email (shiftbloom account). Everything behind sign-in is private to the airline's members and not meant to be indexed.
